overview_description.description:
Fazz enables merchants from SMEs to Enterprises to accept payments, transfer, bank, and invest. The firm offers Fazz Agen, an agent-based financial application serving micro and small businesses in Indonesia. Fazz Business is a business account to help startups, MSMEs, and large corporations build, run, and grow their businesses across Southeast Asia by providing the ability to pay and receive payments, grow capital, and get funding.

The company was founded in 2016 and is based in Singapore and Indonesia. PayFazz and Xfers merged and formed Fazz.
